question: What is Diginex

beats.line: Diginex is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.
beats.headline: ONE PLATFORM
beats.action: A halftone stack of paper documents drops onto open violet ground and settles square.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex is repositioning itself as a unified sustainability, data and compliance platform.

beats.line: It provides software and advisory solutions helping organisations collect, manage and report ESG and supply-chain data.
beats.headline: ESG DATA
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge; the top sheet of the document stack lifts and folds upright into a paper screen, and a cream paper ribbon runs from the document stack to that screen.
beats.delivery: It provides software and advisory solutions helping organisations collect, manage and report ESG and supply-chain data.

beats.line: Following acquisitions, it is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The previous chip flips away; the paper screen tips flat and unfolds into one wide platform sheet beside the document stack, the cream ribbon already in place between them.
beats.delivery: Following acquisitions, it is evolving from point solutions into a fully integrated end-to-end platform.

beats.line: Enterprises face fragmented, manual processes for ESG and supply-chain compliance.
beats.headline: FRAGMENTED WORK
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the ground turns cyan; the folded platform sheet is ruled into a paper grid, and torn paper strips scatter unevenly across its squares.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Enterprises face fragmented, manual processes for ESG and supply-chain compliance.

beats.line: Unified in one platform, it targets regulated banks and asset managers facing ESG disclosure requirements.
beats.headline: BANKS & FUNDS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge; the torn strips press down into the paper grid's squares, and a blue paper arrow runs from the grid to a cutout paper bank building that rises at the right.
beats.delivery: Unified in one platform, it targets regulated banks and asset managers facing ESG disclosure requirements.

beats.line: Diginex is in active integration mode after the one point five billion dollar Resulticks acquisition.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the ground turns magenta; the paper bank building's facade peels forward into a single paper ledger sheet, and paper coins stack heavily at its corner.
beats.delivery: [excited] Diginex is in active integration mode after the one point five billion dollar Resulticks acquisition.

beats.line: General and administrative expenses rose three point four million, to eight point one million.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the right edge; the coins fold up into a paper bar chart whose columns climb, a black string runs from the ledger sheet to that chart, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '$2.2M' sits beside the string with a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: General and administrative expenses rose three point four million, to eight point one million.

beats.line: It has absorbed four distinct businesses across multiple jurisdictions. Integration execution is the primary risk.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: The previous chip is covered; the bar chart's columns tilt apart into four paper folders that land on the paper ledger sheet, and a paper hand presses the pile flat while the black string stays in place.
beats.delivery: It has absorbed four distinct businesses across multiple jurisdictions. Integration execution is the primary risk.

beats.line: In early September twenty twenty-six, shares traded at one dollar sixteen, market cap around thirty-four million.
beats.headline: $1.16 / $34M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the ground returns to violet; the paper ledger sheet is punched and trimmed into a hole-punched paper price tag, with a few paper coins resting under it.
beats.delivery: In early September twenty twenty-six, shares traded at one dollar sixteen, market cap around thirty-four million.

beats.line: Diginex stays a higher-risk, speculative position, suited to investors patient with multi-year integration.
beats.headline: SPECULATIVE
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the left edge; the paper price tag hinges over and rebuilds itself into the document stack, now with the tag pinned to its top sheet by a cream ribbon.
beats.delivery: Diginex stays a higher-risk, speculative position, suited to investors patient with multi-year integration.
